text: Sam is not happy about this. Sam stays not happy about this for a whole week.
You write it in big letters and tape it to the wall above your bed.
You picture your bedroom. You picture it harder than you have ever pictured anything.
She just hands you a towel. Moms can tell when a question will ruin their whole day.
The driver doesn't notice. The kid at the bus stop definitely does.
A lady reaching for ice cream screams so loud the manager drops a watermelon.
Downstairs, your mom shouts that dinner is ready. You walk down the stairs. Like a normal person. It feels amazing.
